svg.title: Making Money on the Buy
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-buy-ceiling-funnel; chapter number: 6; title: Making Money on the Buy; subtitle: Rosener's liquidity-based buy ceilings applied to Diagnose.com; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Retail Value Estimate; value: 150000; display: $100-150K retail; conversion: Starting point; detail: Rosener's retail range for Diagnose.com; top of range used for the ceilings below.; label: Liquid-Name Buy Ceiling; value: 75000; display: Up to 50% of resale; conversion: 50% of $150K; detail: Upper bound of the 30-50% Rosener pays for liquid names.; label: Liquid-Name Buy Floor; value: 45000; display: 30% of resale; conversion: 30% of $150K; detail: Lower bound of the 30-50% liquid-name band.; label: Actual Media Options Bid; value: 35000; display: About $30-35K; conversion: Stated bid on Diagnose.com; detail: The bid Rosener reported for Diagnose.com at Media Options.; label: Illiquid-Name Buy Ceiling; value: 15000; display: No more than 10% of resale; conversion: 10% of $150K; detail: Rosener's cap for illiquid names, set because only about 10% of a portfolio sells in a lifetime.; caption: Profit is set on the buy. Rosener pays at most 10% of expected resale for illiquid names and 30-50% for liquid ones, and bid about $30-35K on a $100-150K retail name.; assumptions note: The $75K, $45K and $15K stages are arithmetic, applying Rosener's stated percentages to the $150K top of his Diagnose.com range; the retail range and the $30-35K bid are his reported figures.; note: Sources domainsherpa Valuation Room with Drew Rosener (KZqosumnXfg @ 01:09:57) and the 10x ask rule (cb-n0okmiuw @ 00:17:23).

circle.title: label: Retail Value Estimate; value: 150000; display: $100-150K retail; conversion: Starting point; detail: Rosener's retail range for Diagnose.com; top of range used for the ceilings below.
label: Liquid-Name Buy Ceiling; value: 75000; display: Up to 50% of resale; conversion: 50% of $150K; detail: Upper bound of the 30-50% Rosener pays for liquid names.
label: Liquid-Name Buy Floor; value: 45000; display: 30% of resale; conversion: 30% of $150K; detail: Lower bound of the 30-50% liquid-name band.
label: Actual Media Options Bid; value: 35000; display: About $30-35K; conversion: Stated bid on Diagnose.com; detail: The bid Rosener reported for Diagnose.com at Media Options.

label: Illiquid-Name Buy Ceiling; value: 15000; display: No more than 10% of resale; conversion: 10% of $150K; detail: Rosener's cap for illiquid names, set because only about 10% of a portfolio sells in a lifetime.

text.title: Assumptions: The $75K, $45K and $15K stages are arithmetic, applying Rosener's stated percentages to the $150K top of his Diagnose.com range; the retail range and the $30-35K bid are his reported figures.
